Job Summary: This role involves driving strategic initiatives, managing business transformations, and leveraging industry expertise to create value-driven solutions. Roles & Responsibilities: Deliver strategic advice to clients by providing data-driven recommendations that enhance business outcomes. Independently manage communications with clients, ensuring clear understanding of project objectives and progress updates. Design and implement GenAI, RAG, Agentic AI, or traditional AI/ML algorithms tailored to address specific business challenges within the healthcare and life sciences sector. Demonstrate knowledge of life sciences datasets and maintain strong domain expertise to drive the development of robust analytics solutions. Support the delivery of consulting projects for global clients, working as part of a small to medium-sized team or as an individual contributor as required. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, leveraging skills in data engineering, data science, and business intelligence tools such as Power BI or Tableau. Apply design thinking principles and business process optimization to recommend and implement innovative, value-driven solutions. Engage in ongoing learning to develop consulting acumen, industry knowledge, and technical capabilities. WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU? An opportunity to work on high-visibility projects with top Pharma clients around the globe. Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners, and business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies. Ability to embed responsible business into everything—from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional. Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge, and capabilities. Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerating equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization. What you would do in this role Support delivery of small to medium-sized teams to deliver consulting projects for global clients. Responsibilities may include strategy, implementation, process design, and change management for specific modules. Work with the team or as an Individual contributor on the project assigned which includes a variety of skills to be utilized from Data Engineering to Data Science Provide Subject matter expertise in various sub-segments of the LS industry. Develop assets and methodologies, point-of-view, research, or white papers for use by the team and the larger community. Acquire new skills that have utility across industry groups. Support strategies and operating models focused on some business units and assess likely competitive responses. Also, assess implementation readiness and points of greatest impact. Co-lead proposals, and business development efforts and coordinate with other colleagues to create consensus-driven deliverables. Execute a transformational change plan aligned with the client’s business strategy and context for change. Engage stakeholders in the change journey and build commitment to change. Make presentations wherever required to a known audience or client on functional aspects of his or her domain. Who are we looking for? Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Statistics, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or other Quantitative field. Extensive GenAI expertise with a track record of creating and deploying GenAI and Agentic AI solutions. Proven experience (4+ years) in working on Life Sciences/Pharma/Healthcare projects and delivering successful outcomes. Excellent understanding of Pharma data sets – commercial, clinical, RWE (Real World Evidence) & EMR (Electronic medical records) Leverage one’s hands on experience of working across one or more of these areas such as real-world evidence data, R&D clinical data, digital marketing data. Hands-on experience with handling Datasets like Komodo, RAVE, IQVIA, Truven, Optum etc. Hands-on experience in building and deployment of Statistical Models/Machine Learning including Segmentation & predictive modeling, hypothesis testing, multivariate statistical analysis, time series techniques, and optimization. Proficiency in Programming languages such as Python, SQL, Spark, etc. Ability to work with large data sets and present findings/insights to key stakeholders; Data management using databases like SQL. Experience with any of the cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud for deploying and scaling language models. Experience with any of the Data Visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI, Qlikview, Spotfire is good to have. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven mindset. Proficient in Excel, MS Word, PowerPoint, etc. Ability to solve complex business problems and deliver client delight. Strong writing skills to build points of view on current industry trends. Good communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills Professional & Technical Skills: - Relevant experience in the required domain. - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. - Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Additional Information: - Opportunity to work on innovative projects. - Career growth and leadership exposure. About Our Company | Accenture

The role translates high-level behavioral requirements, hypothetical test intents and diagrams into clear, parameterized test scenarios. The Senior Analyst will independently handle assigned testing activities, analyze results, investigate defects and work with software and simulation engineering teams to resolve issues. The focus is on delivering diverse, robust scenarios that test the intended behavior while respecting physical and logical constraints, with clear documentation and handovers across US and India teams. Roles & Responsibilities: Plan and execute assigned scenario generation, testing and maintenance activities in line with the agreed test strategy and delivery plan. Analyze high-level test intents, diagrams and behavioral requirements to define scenario specifications, parameters and acceptance criteria clarify gaps with the Test Lead and engineering teams. Design diverse scenario permutations using combinatorial testing to meet coverage goals while avoiding unnecessary duplication. Analyze interactions between software modules, state machines, environmental physics and simulator configurations to ensure scenarios test the intended system behavior. Develop and maintain reusable configuration rules and parameter sets for reliable bulk generation and execution across automated data pipelines. Apply scenario quality checks, boundary conditions, tolerances and metrics to distinguish genuine behavioral issues from acceptable execution variation. Execute scenarios, analyze results and investigate failures document reproducible defects and work with software and simulation engineering teams on retesting and closure. Update assigned scenarios as requirements, simulator configurations and testing methodologies evolve, and assess the impact on existing coverage. Estimate effort for assigned work, track progress and provide clear handovers across US and India teams escalate dependencies and delivery blockers to the Test Lead. Participate in peer reviews and share technical knowledge with colleagues working across simulation engineering, technical art, level design and procedural generation. Maintain accurate records of scenario coverage, execution results, defects and maintenance needs, and communicate findings and technical risks to the Test Lead and relevant engineers. Support evolving methods, including synthetic transformation of logged events and procedural agent injection into real-world telemetry Professional & Technical Skills: Work planning and ownership: Ability to estimate effort, prioritize assigned activities and deliver testing and maintenance work against agreed timelines. Technical independence: Ability to develop and troubleshoot scenarios independently, seek clarification when needed and contribute to peer reviews and knowledge sharing. Analytical thinking: Strong problem-solving skills to break down complex requirements, identify dependencies and make evidence-based decisions. Clear communication: Ability to explain test findings, defects, technical constraints and risks clearly to the Test Lead and engineering stakeholders. Global collaboration: Ability to work effectively with distributed teams, communicate dependencies and maintain clear cross-location handovers. Quality focus: A structured approach to scenario checks, documentation, traceability and reproducible issue reporting. Adaptability: Ability to work with different specialist skills and adjust testing approaches as methods and tools evolve Systems architecture and modular thinking: Strong understanding of interdependent software architectures, state machines and the interactions between software modules, environmental physics and simulator configurations. Parametric design and spatial logic: Ability to apply Boolean logic, geometric constraints and time-based conditions to dynamic 3D environments. Synthetic scenario design: Ability to translate abstract test intents and diagrams into realistic, varied scenarios that challenge behavioral requirements without violating physical or logical constraints. Combinatorial testing: Ability to design parameter combinations that provide broad, meaningful coverage without unnecessary overlap. Algorithmic scalability: Ability to define reusable, programmatic rulesets and configurations that remain reliable across variable inputs and high-volume automated pipelines. Robustness and boundary value analysis: Strong understanding of edge cases, tolerances and metrics that isolate the intended signal while allowing acceptable execution variation. Simulation configuration: Ability to review and troubleshoot scenario configurations, system states and simulator behavior. Tools and configuration languages: Experience with visual node-based tools such as Unreal Engine Blueprints or Unity, or configuration languages such as JSON and XML, is beneficial. Scenario lifecycle management: Ability to maintain reusable scenario libraries and assess the impact of changes to requirements, configurations and simulation environments. Evolving testing methods: Understanding of synthetic transformation of logged events and procedural agent injection into real-world telemetry is beneficial. Additional Information: - The candidate should have minimum 7 years of experience in Embedded Product Verification & Validation with 5 years of Exp in Synthetic test Generation. - This position is based at our Bengaluru office. - A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering Computer or Electrical Engineering Automotive Engineering (Systems and Controls), Applied Mathematics, Physics, or equivalent technical experience is required.

Prototype rapidly, demonstrate frequently, and evolve prototypes into scalable production systems with security and compliance baked in. Solid software engineering discipline: clean design, testing mindset, CI/CD orientation, and production readiness. AI native build capability: LLM integration, retrieval grounding, tool orchestration, evaluation loops, and safety boundaries. Secondary / Strongly Beneficial Skills OData/service design patterns, API lifecycle management, and contract-first development. Strong mathematical reasoning skills, capable of deriving explanations for structural behaviours and identifying how graph knowledge models should evolve. Programming proficiency in Python, Java, and/or Scala, with the ability to work effectively with graph-related, reasoning-oriented, or enterprise integration frameworks. Experience applying graph-theoretical analysis in telecom or other complex system domains. Familiarity with GQL or SPARQL query concepts and graph-query patterns used in knowledge-graph environments. Understanding of how graph-based reasoning supports autonomous decision-making frameworks Exposure to graph-based modelling in large-scale distributed environments, with the ability to interpret and reason about such structures. Formal academic background in mathematics or a closely related field, particularly with exposure to graph theory or combinatorics. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to communicate complex mathematical concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders Demonstrated ability to work in cross-functional teams and drive innovation. The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on expertise in computational fluid dynamics and thermal simulation, combined with applied proficiency in Physics AI techniques - Reduced Order Modeling (ROM), surrogate modeling, and Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs), to transform high-fidelity simulation outputs into fast, deployable AI models at client scale. In this role, you will run parametric CFD and continuous process simulations, build Physics AI pipelines that convert simulation data into real-time predictive models, and contribute to a tool-agnostic platform that serves clients across industries. Ensure accurate physics representation, coupling strategies and scaling workflows through automation, HPC, and cloud deployment. Implement cross-domain and hybrid simulations, combining discrete-event modeling for factory workflows with physics-based models for material, fluid, and thermal processes. Design and execute parametric simulation studies using structured Design of Experiments (DOE), sampling strategies (Latin Hypercube, Sobol), and output extraction protocols to generate Physics AI training datasets. Develop and integrate ROMs, Surrogate models and Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) for fluid and thermal problems embedding governing equations (Navier-Stokes, heat equation, species transport) as physics constraints in neural network training loss, enabling physically consistent predictions from sparse simulation data. Develop virtual sensor and derived variable models: extract ROM field predictions at specific spatial locations to simulate real-time sensor readings. Compute derived engineering KPIs, including remaining useful life (RUL), energy efficiency, yield uniformity from ROM outputs using physics-based and data-driven methods. Champion co-simulation architectures, surrogate modeling, and tool integration across commercial software (ANSYS, COMSOL, Abaqus) and scripting environments (Python, MATLAB, Modelica). Provide technical leadership and mentorship, guiding engineering teams in scalable simulation, best practices and architectural patterns. Actively lead and participate in sales pursuits and pre-sales engagements, with responsibility for new project wins. This will involve multiple discussions and presentation of our capability and solutions to potential clients and other Accenture stakeholders/leaders. Active participation and leadership in driving industry related thought leadership activities like patents, authoring whitepapers/POVs, proof of concepts, conference/academia presentations, capability presentations etc. Work with global clients and cross-functional teams in a multicultural and distributed environment. Professional and Technical Skills: Must Have Skills: Hands-on CFD simulation expertise with at least one primary solver - Ansys Fluent, OpenFOAM, or STAR-CCM+ covering mesh generation, boundary condition setup, turbulence modeling (k-e, k-w SST, LES), multiphase flow (VOF, Eulerian), conjugate heat transfer, and species transport for industrial-scale problems. Strong numerical foundations in finite volume method, discretisation schemes, pressure-velocity coupling (SIMPLE, PISO), solver stability, and mesh quality assessment with the ability to diagnose and resolve convergence issues independently. Applied knowledge of Physics AI methods: Reduced Order Modeling (ROM) using POD/SVD, surrogate modeling (Gaussian Process, Gradient Boosting, Neural Network), and DOE sampling strategies (LHS, Sobol, CCD) with the ability to connect CFD simulation outputs to Physics AI training pipelines. Proficiency in Python for simulation automation and Physics AI development: NumPy, SciPy, Pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch, h5py (HDF5 storage), Matplotlib, and PyVista (3D field visualisation). Familiarity with PyFluent, PyFOAM, or equivalent CFD Python APIs for programmatic solver control and result extraction. Ability to extract, structure, and manage large field datasets (full nodal arrays: velocity, pressure, temperature) from CFD solver result files - cas/dat, VTK, RST, HDF5 formats - for Physics AI model training. Creating digital twins, performing physics-based simulation, rendering RTX environments, or synthetic data workflows for real-time industrial applications. Cloud engineering background, including automation, orchestration, and deployment of simulation pipelines in scalable environments. Experience with manufacturing, industrial automation, automotive, or aerospace sectors. Good to Have Skills: Exposure to Ansys Twin Builder, FMI/FMU standard, or digital twin integration - deploying ROM as an FMU for system-level simulation or real-time inferencing in an operational environment. Experience in scripting and automation, e.g. Python, C++, MATLAB, Modelica. Background in digital twin development for factory planning, robotics simulation, or predictive maintenance. Knowledge of NVIDIA Omniverse and Isaac Sim. Familiarity with FMI/FMU, OpenModelica, OpenUSD, or robotics simulation standards. Exposure to AI/ML-driven simulation workflows, Physics-informed ML, surrogate modeling, generative AI tools for model generation and behavior prediction. Additional Info: This position is based at Bengaluru, Pune Candidate should have 10-12 years of experience Bachelor s or master s in engineering, Physics
